frozenHoldout.note: Frozen before any training run (ADR-0015 law). Moving a mutation across this line is a reviewed edit of tools/training/build_repair_split.py, never a re-run.

notes: Regenerate with tools/training/build_repair_split.py; CI checks freshness. The Kaggle repair kernel consumes train.jsonl, holdout.jsonl and this manifest; the holdout is judged by tools/training/eval_repair.py against the real engine.
